notes.multiplierSource: TechWiser All Mutations table updated 2026-07-08 (primary for Nx values). Older TechWiser +% bonuses and Propelrc Nx values conflict and were not used when they disagree with the July table.
notes.dropChanceSource: TechWiser July 2026 table for listed rates. Rarer band (0.5–0.9%) also matches Fandom for shared names. Fandom lists lower rates for Stone/Gold/Ghost (1.4%/1.2%/1%) — July values preferred as the full multi+rate table.
notes.excluded: Shiny, Big, Sparkling (attributes). Abyssal (TBA only). Festive, Frightful, Sandy, Coral (single weak source). fishit.web.id rejected as Fisch content.

item.name: Galaxy
item.howToGet: Random chance on any catch. Stack mutation-chance enchants, bobbers, totems, and potions to improve odds.
item.cardSummary: Bright space-look mutation with the highest standard sell multiplier in the reconciled table.

item.name: Midnight
item.howToGet: Random chance on any catch. Night fishing and Stargazer-style luck boosts are commonly used when farming mutations.
item.cardSummary: Dark blue glow mutation near the top of the standard sell-value ladder.

item.name: Gemstone
item.howToGet: Random chance on any catch. Treat as a rare high-value roll alongside Galaxy and Midnight.
item.cardSummary: Crystalline color-shift look that ties Midnight for the second-highest standard multiplier.

item.name: Lightning
item.howToGet: Random chance on any catch. Visual variants exist, but they still count as the same Lightning mutation.
item.cardSummary: Yellow spark particle mutation with strong mid-to-high sell value.

item.name: Radioactive
item.howToGet: Random chance on any catch. Mutation-chance gear raises the odds of landing any standard mutation, including this one.
item.cardSummary: Green toxic glow mutation with a solid four-times sell multiplier.

item.name: Corrupt
item.howToGet: Random chance on any catch. Rarer than Radioactive at the same multiplier tier.
item.cardSummary: Glitchy dark-texture mutation that matches Radioactive’s 4x sell value at a lower drop rate.

item.name: Gold
item.howToGet: Random chance on any catch. The Gold Digger enchant specifically raises the chance of Gold.
item.cardSummary: Golden glow mutation that is easier to target with Gold Digger than other high-value rolls.

item.name: Fairy Dust
item.howToGet: Random chance on any catch. Same multiplier band as Gold, but rarer on the July rate table.
item.cardSummary: Pastel sparkle mutation with Gold-tier value and a lower listed drop chance.

item.name: Ghost
item.howToGet: Random chance on any catch. Common early-to-mid money mutation while you build mutation-chance gear.
item.cardSummary: Pale ethereal glow mutation with a mid-tier sell multiplier and a relatively common rate.

item.name: Holographic
item.howToGet: Random chance on any catch. Multiplier and rate come from the July TechWiser table only; confirm in-game if balance changes.
item.cardSummary: Shimmering holographic look sitting just under Ghost on the standard multiplier list.

item.name: Albino
item.howToGet: Random chance on any catch. One of the more common white-look mutations used for steady sell upgrades.
item.cardSummary: Clean white-texture mutation with a modest multiplier and a high relative drop rate.

item.name: Stone
item.howToGet: Random chance on any catch. Entry-level rocky mutation; Fandom lists a lower rate than the July table used here.
item.cardSummary: Rocky look mutation and the most common standard roll on the preferred July rate table.

item.name: Frozen
item.howToGet: Random chance on any catch. Name is multi-sourced; sell multiplier and exact base rate are left blank because sources disagree.
item.cardSummary: Ice-crystal look mutation confirmed by name across guides, with sell value still unreconciled.

item.name: Crystallized
item.howToGet: Can appear while fishing, with better odds when using Crystals mined from Glowing Crystals in Crystal Depths (Pickaxe quest unlock). Also written Crystalized in some guides.
item.cardSummary: Crystal Depths-era mutation whose odds improve with mined Crystals rather than pure open-world RNG alone.

item.name: Leviathan's Rage
item.howToGet: Leviathan / admin-hosted event exclusive. Not treated as an always-available random pool mutation.
item.cardSummary: Event-gated mutation tied to Leviathan admin activity rather than normal daily fishing.
